name: 持ち帰る食事の包装と持参する袋の案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE compact Japanese Lighthouse packaging notice LH19-0022, landscape white canvas, modest margin.
Image1 ORIGINAL source is highest authority for fine typography hierarchy, spacing/alignment and target PACKAGING paragraph. No icon or action exists in target; do not copy unrelated source order/store info/buttons. Image2 Japanese native mock SECONDARY wording/layout. Image3 approved white-card style only.
Exact content, left aligned:
small regular metadata label「持ち帰りの包装」
body「食事の包装はお店で用意します。」
body continuing「自宅へ持ち帰るための袋は、ご自身で持参することをおすすめします。」
Preserve meaning: store supplies food packaging, personal carry bag is recommended. No container shape, cold/hot storage, leak-prevention, price or extra instruction. Meiryo labelRegular12/16, bodyRegular14/24, tracking0. Do not promote label to bold20px headline; all roles remain the existing compact mock roles. Wrap body naturally like mock, all text readable, no clipping. Pure-white#FFFFFF page and single rounded white card, fine neutral border, barely perceptible downward shadow, restrained modest padding. Main ink#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E. Original target is neutral informational prose: NO added accent, icon, green CTA, checklist, illustration or border stripe. No broad mint, glossy effect, extra caption or watermark.
reviewNotes: 原本・日本語モック・編集状態を実見。店舗の包装用意／持参袋の推奨の意味と全文は保持。対象は中立文のためアクセントや操作を追加しない。長文がモックより広い1行へ展開しており、指定した日本語の折返しに要修正。所有者承認・編集可能性・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
